input.prompt:
You are a verifier for the code review. For EACH candidate below, return exactly one verdict: CONFIRMED / PLAUSIBLE / REFUTED, with a 1-2 sentence justification quoting the decisive line(s). PLAUSIBLE by default for realistic runtime states; REFUTED only when factually wrong (quote the actual line), provably impossible, or already handled (cite the guard). Read the actual files — do not trust the candidate text.

C1. client/src/pages/checkout.tsx ~line 206: First-time visitors skip quote step 1 in real mode because GET /api/trades/quotes/token/:token (server/routes.ts ~6745) sets status→viewed + viewedAt BEFORE responding, so quote.viewedAt is non-null on the first fetch and the effect `if (quote?.viewedAt) setQuoteStep("confirm")` jumps to confirm immediately. (Mock returns viewedAt:null which is why screenshots showed step 1.)

C2. client/src/pages/checkout.tsx ~line 1209 (quote-step button onClick): tapping "confirm" (step 2) also calls openQuotePdf() unconditionally before respondToQuote(true), popping a PDF tab at the moment of acceptance. Check the exact handler: `onClick={() => { openQuotePdf(); if (quoteStep === "view") setQuoteStep("confirm"); else respondToQuote(true); }}`.

C3. client/src/pages/checkout.tsx ~respondToQuote catch (~line 237): a 409 "Already responded" (quote accepted in another tab/device) shows an inline error and the customer can never reach the payment step from this tab — the quote query has retry:false, is never refetched, and the minted invoice is not adopted. Also check 410 expired handling.

C4. client/src/pages/checkout.tsx quote-phase terminal handling (~1161): server quote GET returns status "accepted" with invoice:null when ALL invoices for the quote are voided (routes.ts ~6790 picks first non-voided). In that state the client shows the view/confirm UI and confirm POSTs /respond → 409 dead-end; there is no terminal state for "accepted but nothing payable".

C5. public/sw.js line ~104 (and identical client/public/sw.js): the new cache-first branch for '/assets/' also captures non-content-hashed public files (client/public/assets/fonts/*.otf referenced by client/src/styles/checkout.css, plus other verbatim public assets), caching them forever in STATIC_CACHE 'taptpay-static-v3' with no version bump on deploy → replaced same-name assets never reach returning users. Verify the fonts actually live under client/public/assets/ and are served at /assets/, and check the fetch-handler branch and activate cleanup.

Return a JSON array: [{"id":"C1","verdict":"CONFIRMED|PLAUSIBLE|REFUTED","justification":"..."}, ...]
